tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Find source by path, text, symbol, or references. For JS/TS semantic references, set mode to references and query to a symbol sN alias or path#qualifiedName; results state compiler project scope and any lexical fallback. Bare-name fallback proposes nextSearches; choose the intended declaration. Search results do not authorize edits: read the target first. Whitespace separates query terms; punctuation stays literal. Scope accepts paths and *, **, ?, or {a,b} globs; multiple scopes use an array such as ["src","spec"]. Spaces in a scope string are literal. Returns up to eight short results; generated outputs and node_modules are excluded.

scope.description: One literal path/glob, or multiple scopes as an array, e.g. ["src","spec"]. A space in one string belongs to that path.

tools.name: read_code
tools.description: Read a text file or local image, compact directory, sN alias, path#qualifiedName, @changes, @checks, or @capabilities. @checks lists current-source check observations without running them; unknown counts stay null. A line range selects those lines; otherwise omit view for automatic raw/outline routing. Truncated reads propose nextRead and outline routes without granting unseen coverage. Use view signature on a symbol to inspect its declaration header without its body; read the symbol body before behavioral edits or rename. Symbol outlines list contained declarations. Results expose editTargets and containedBy relationships. Generated outputs and node_modules are excluded.

tools.name: edit_code
tools.description: Atomically apply symbol operations or focused Cline patches. Each operation uses kind "symbol" or "patch"; symbol edits put the edit action in action. Example: {"operations":[{"kind":"symbol","target":"s1","action":"replace_body","content":"return 2;"}]}. For configured JS/TS, action "rename" with content containing only the new identifier computes related edits via the compiler, preserving existing aliases; first read the complete target declaration. Rename must be the sole operation in a batch; unavailable/incomplete projects or name capture are blocked. Its static guard is not test evidence; run required checks after editing. Set patch target to an observed sN alias to restrict one Update File to that symbol; the header must match its file. Choose the smaller precise edit: replace_body replaces the entire observed body. For a brace-delimited body, unbraced content inherits existing indentation; one-line content becomes inline. Include the outer braces to preserve explicit layout, or use a file patch. For a new file, patch may contain complete raw text; existing files require Cline patch syntax. Do not combine a parent with its containedBy child. The runtime handles freshness, overlaps, and supported syntax checks.

target.description: Observed symbol alias. Restricts one Update File patch to this symbol; its header must match the alias path. Omit target for a deliberate file/multi-file patch; explicit headers select those files.

path.description: Target for raw content or a patch without file headers. Explicit patch headers select their own files.

patch.description:
For an existing file: *** Begin Patch
*** Update File: file.ts
@@
-old line
+new line
*** End Patch. For a new path, complete raw content is also accepted.

tools.name: run_task
tools.description: Run project tasks, inspections, generators, formatters, or requested setup. A command still running after the initial wait returns a session-bound rN id; inspect that id with the returned cursor to receive only new output without relaunching it. Source changes are journaled and require a subsequent check. Explicit calls execute; finish_task reuses fresh validation. Use the dependency operation for Node packages and native commands for other ecosystems. For requested services, detach the process and redirect its input/output so the command can finish. Prettier on explicit files uses atomic edits. Test results include reporting counters; null is unknown and pending is distinct from skipped. Returns bounded output and code/environment diagnostics.

args.description: Extra argv for a test task, such as filters or --run. Keep task equal to its catalog ID; arguments are passed literally, without shell expansion.

kind.description: Node package.json dependencies only; use command for other package managers.

tools.name: finish_task
tools.description: Finish with a concise factual summary. Use run_task reporting or read_code @checks for test counts: null is unknown, pending is distinct from skipped, and unreported categories must not become zero. Separate commands run, passing tests, admitted verification and user criteria. Mention a non-obvious durable implementation decision only when it helps future work. The runtime checks known changes, reuses current checks, and refreshes relevant checks already requested in this session. Work without a current check is reported as unverified. Do not provide receipts or internal state.
